SCENE CONTEXT
Evening living room, medium two-shot. the man (29, Korean, round gold wire glasses, jet-black two-block hair, navy overshirt open over a white T-shirt, company ID badge on a navy lanyard) sits on the caramel corduroy sofa, hands on his knees, staring at a smartphone held in front of them. the woman (27, Filipino-American, warm golden-tan skin, long dark wavy hair with curtain bangs, white poplin shirt with cuffed sleeves, dark-indigo jeans, small gold hoops) leans over the sofa back from the left, her head beside his, her right hand holding the phone so its screen faces them, her left hand on the backrest.

FORMAT MODE
One continuous shot, no cuts.

CAMERA
Fixed camera on a tripod, exactly the framing of the start image, no zoom, no pan, no handheld sway. Modern Korean sitcom look: clean, natural warm colors, evening indoor lighting with warm lamps and string lights, window dark navy, no film grain, no over-sharpening.

ACTION
0.0s to 0.6s: his eyes move from the phone screen up to her face beside him. 0.6s to 2.6s: he asks his line slowly. 2.6s to 3.0s: she bites her lip, nodding slightly; he stares.

PERFORMANCE
He is incredulous. She is delighted. No exaggerated acting, no look at the camera.

AUDIO
Quiet living-room ambience only (soft refrigerator hum). No music, no notification sounds, no vibration, no door sounds.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Continue exactly from the start image. Both people keep the same face, hair, glasses, clothes and position through the whole take. Same room, furniture, lamps and colors. No new people enter. No subtitles, no on-screen text, no watermark.

DIALOGUE
The man says in natural native Korean, low and dry, incredulous, slow, rising at the end: "지금 내 표정을 보고한 거야?" He says only this one line and nothing else; no other words in any language. Natural delivery, visible lip-sync, mouth movements match every word, no subtitles, no on-screen text. The other person says nothing.
